headlines.text: Rewind to 2024, when it was title-change night for the ROH World Six Man Tag Titles as Gunns & White vs. The Embassy battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.14 ? ending the champion's reign at 5 defenses. It was the first title opportunity of Gunns & White's career. With Bullet Club Gold's grip on the six-man titles fading, Jay White and the Gunns capitalized when The Acclaimed's Anthony Bowens stopped Prince Nana from interfering, letting White hit the Blade Runner to seize the ROH Six-Man Tag Titles from Mogul Embassy.

On this day in 2026, the AEW World Trios Titles changed hands as JetSpeed & Page vs. The Opps (Hobbs, Joe & Shibata) battled it out, appearing on Collision, rated 6.56 ? ending the champion's reign at 6 defenses. For JetSpeed & Page, it marked a first real shot at championship gold. Page and JetSpeed dethroned The Opps to become new AEW World Trios Champions.

That Wednesday in 2024, the AEW World Heavyweight Title was up for grabs as Samoa Joe vs. Hook went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 7.83 ? a strong outing. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: On this day in 2024, Beretta & Cassidy kicked off their AEW journey as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.44.
On this day in 2026, it was a long-awaited, welcome sight as Ortiz returned to the ring after 2 years away, appearing on Collision.
Turning the clock back to 2026: Alexander, Clon & Fletcher made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Collision, rated 6.22.
